Upstream project: https://gitlab.com/raykzhao/matrict_plus
Reference commit: b24f3176d2db15ca55d91c8c9cbe1cef201c5d2d
Upstream directory: asymmetric_sis_estimate/
License: BSD-0-Clause (copied as LICENSE-BSD-0-Clause.txt)

The bundled proba_util.py byte-matches the upstream file at the reference
commit. MSIS_security.py and model_BKZ.py are derived copies with local
compatibility and runtime changes: integer normalization for current Sage/Python
types, guarded trivial block sizes, quieter progress output, and coarser default
search steps. The artifact's driver explicitly sets STEPS_b=1 and STEPS_m=10
before every selector A-MSIS run and validates its accelerated cost calculation
against the bundled reference calculation at sampled points.
